jsonOptions.prompt: Extract only assertions supported by this form. Return JSON fields agency, rule_citations, proposed_action, hearing_status, filing_date, hearing_request_duration_days, hearing_request_anchor, public_comment_duration_days, public_comment_anchor, comment_close, effective_date, final_action. Include evidence quotes and unknowns. Distinguish marked choices from blank options and distinguish date roles. Do not compute unstated dates.
